name: holocron-vr
description: Explore your codebase as an immersive 3D VR constellation powered by Graphify knowledge graphs.

scripts.build:wasm: emcc wasm-src/layout_engine.cpp -O3 -msimd128 -flto -s WASM=1 -s MODULARIZE=1 -s EXPORT_ES6=1 -s ENVIRONMENT='worker' -s INITIAL_MEMORY=33554432 -s MAXIMUM_MEMORY=52428800 -s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1 -s EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS='["_init_graph","_get_node_input_ptr","_get_edge_input_ptr","_compute_layout","_get_positions_ptr","_update_positions","_get_node_count","_free_memory","_set_convergence_threshold","_set_repulsion_k","_set_attraction_k","_set_damping","_set_max_iterations","_set_scene_radius"]' -s EXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS='["ccall","cwrap"]' -o frontend/layout_engine.mjs
scripts.build:wasm:debug: emcc wasm-src/layout_engine.cpp -O0 -g -msimd128 -s WASM=1 -s MODULARIZE=1 -s EXPORT_ES6=1 -s ENVIRONMENT='worker' -s ASSERTIONS=2 -s INITIAL_MEMORY=33554432 -s MAXIMUM_MEMORY=52428800 -s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1 -s EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS='["_init_graph","_get_node_input_ptr","_get_edge_input_ptr","_compute_layout","_get_positions_ptr","_update_positions","_get_node_count","_free_memory","_set_convergence_threshold","_set_repulsion_k","_set_attraction_k","_set_damping","_set_max_iterations","_set_scene_radius"]' -s EXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS='["ccall","cwrap"]' -o frontend/layout_engine_debug.mjs
scripts.bench:all: npm run bench:layout && npm run bench:fps && npm run bench:memory
scripts.preview: vite build && echo '--- dist/ contents ---' && find dist -type f

author: Yoda-Man
